Interactive packet generator that builds topology, runs tiles, and shows live network stats.

# Purpose
This file implements the `pktgen` development command for Firedancer. It builds a custom topology with `fd_topob_new`, adds the `net`, `metric`, and `pktgen` tiles, sets CPU affinity from `config->development.pktgen.affinity`, and validates the fake destination IP in `config->development.pktgen.fake_dst_ip`. It also creates the links needed for packet generation and metric collection, then finishes the topology setup with `fd_topob_finish` and prints the resulting layout.

The command function `pktgen_cmd_fn` starts the topology, configures network and metric settings, installs XDP, joins shared workspaces, and runs the tiles in one process with `fd_topo_run_single_process`. After startup, it enters a simple terminal loop that shows live packet and buffer statistics with [`render_status`](<#render_status>) and accepts `start`, `stop`, and `quit` commands. The file ends by registering `fd_action_pktgen`, which exposes the command as a development action named `pktgen` with the description `Flood interface with invalid Ethernet frames`.
